# Cinematic Arts (CA)

> Clothing and accessories storefront based in Peshawar, Pakistan, selling women's unstitched suits, boys' trousers, jackets, hoodies, shirts, t-shirts, and accessories in PKR with Cash on Delivery and verified Seller-Referred Monthly Installment Plans.

## Store Details
- Brand Name: Cinematic Arts (CA)
- Location: Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
- Currency: PKR (Pakistani Rupee)
- Categories: Women's Unstitched, Boys' Trousers, Jackets, Hoodies, Shirts, T-Shirts, Accessories
- Website: https://cinematicartstore.netlify.app/
- Email: cinematicartsofficial.io@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92-335-5329722 (03355329722)

## Payment & Shipping Summary
- Cash on Delivery (COD): Available across Pakistan with no referral code required.
- Monthly Installments: 2-month (15% markup), 3-month (25% markup), and 4-month (40% markup) schedules in PKR using a verified Seller Referral ID (CA-XXXXXX).
- Exchanges & Returns: Unworn items and uncut unstitched fabrics may be exchanged within 7 calendar days of delivery.
